problem.clean_repo_case: Prior recovery contract expected 016 but an earlier operator version only emitted it for dirty repositories.
problem.early_write_case: Writing 016 into the repository before stash/fetch/sync could itself dirty a clean repo or be included in a dirty-repo stash, interfering with the clean/exact-head gate.

fix.capture: Pre-recovery git status and dirty entries are captured in memory before stash/fetch/sync.
fix.dirty_state: Only pre-existing dirty/untracked state is stashed with include-untracked; no automatic pop.
fix.sync: Atomic fetch followed by ancestry-gated merge --ff-only; hard reset is forbidden.
fix.publication: 016 snapshot is published by the receipt path only on successful/blocked recovery exit after capture; it is not written before synchronization.
fix.coverage: The snapshot payload is produced for both originally-clean and originally-dirty repositories after the capture point.
